description: The tabular-data set: a horizontally scrollable container around a semantic <table>. The container takes size (default/sm) and variant (default/plain); TableHead and TableCell can pin to the start or end edge. The DS recipe reads these off data-size / data-variant / data-sticky. The container also takes tone (neutral/accent, data-tone), which colours selected rows: neutral is the muted fill with primary text, accent the opt-in primary wash with accent text.
